name: openbb_balance_sheet
description:
Balance sheets (assets, liabilities, equity, cash, debt) for one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.balance).
Returns: {symbol, statements: [one record per period with period_ending, fiscal period and the line items]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; period (annual or quarter; default annual); limit (number of periods; default 5); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp, intrinio, polygon, sec, yfinance; default yfinance, no key).
Related: openbb_income_statement, openbb_cash_flow; other sources: yf_balance_sheet, av_balance_sheet. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "quarter", "limit": 4, "provider": "yfinance"}
